visibility: evaluator_only_in_real_tests; this demo is intentionally shareable

expression_language.status: 本样例的受限表达式，仅供数据契约与计算校验

fact_policy.new_claims: Validate against the input table with an independently checked bounded query; do not reject merely because absent from the catalog.
fact_policy.numeric_matching: Verify entity, year, field, unit, operation, baseline and rounding; never nearest-number matching.
fact_policy.zero_denominator: undefined; do not fabricate a ratio
fact_policy.display_tolerance: Use declared display precision and validated encoding-specific measurement tolerance; no universal 1-percent tolerance.

required_units.meaning: 量化A从2022到2023年的用户变化

accepted_routes.semantic_condition: Clearly establish the before-after change for A
Identify A, time range and absolute increase with correct units
Identify A, time range, baseline and relative growth

required_units.visual_evidence_rule: A的变化由编码正确、可辨认的数据图形或结构化数值比较支持；不是仅旁白字幕

required_units.meaning: 量化B从2022到2023年的用户变化

accepted_routes.semantic_condition: Clearly establish the before-after change for B
Identify B, time range and absolute increase with correct units
Identify B, time range, baseline and relative growth

required_units.visual_evidence_rule: B的变化由编码正确、可辨认的数据图形或结构化数值比较支持；不是仅旁白字幕

required_units.meaning: 明确A增长更快并提供口径一致的量化比较证据

accepted_routes.semantic_condition: Explicit correct comparison of relative growth rates
Correctly identify the ratio as a ratio of growth rates
Correctly express the gap in percentage points
Establish equal starting values and compare absolute increases

required_units.visual_evidence_rule: 跨区域证据可比较：共同或明确可换算的尺度与统计口径；比较发生时关键信息可获得；不能仅写A更快

temporal_policies.anchor: Generated audio claims; use readable semantic annotations and scene context for unspoken units
temporal_policies.repeat_policy: After merging one continuous exposition, inspect every semantically matched occurrence; a substantive mistimed/conflicting repetition prevents binary T pass. Report occurrence-level diagnostics separately.
requirements: normal entry-transition frames are not treated as settled numeric claims
temporal_policies.tolerances: Calibrate on development data and freeze before test; no numeric threshold is asserted here.

scoring_policy.weighting: equal over the three required units
scoring_policy.core_conflict_rule: An explicit contradictory statement in any visible/audible channel fails the affected C unit after adjudication.
scoring_policy.extra_claims: audit separately; correct new insights allowed; unsupported new claims penalized by factuality metrics
scoring_policy.unresolved: report lower and upper bounds until adjudicated; do not silently drop
scoring_policy.infrastructure_failure: rerun or unavailable, not a model failure
scoring_policy.quality_judgment: separate calibrated narrative clarity, readability and animation effectiveness
